description: Solo-dev workflow/template pack for basecoat-sheen, running on a SHARED enterprise EMU instance. The 'solo-dev' choice governs only the local authoring ceremony (lightweight workflow + template pack, local telemetry/secrets, no hooks). It does NOT govern merges: the enterprise EMU org/enterprise rulesets are the authoritative branch governance for main (see enterprise_governance).
source: Derived from vendor/basecoat/scripts/bootstrap.ps1 profile table (solo-dev). Merge governance is enterprise-managed (EMU), not repo-level.

branch_protection.note: Repo-level branch protection is intentionally not set; the enterprise EMU rulesets below are authoritative and cannot be relaxed from this repo.
branch_protection.self_merge_note: The org ruleset requires 0 human approvals, so a maintainer may merge their own PR, but ONLY after all enterprise checks pass (CodeQL code scanning, code quality, Copilot code review). Do NOT use admin/force bypass on a shared instance.

enterprise_governance.instance_type: EMU (Enterprise Managed Users), shared across the enterprise
enterprise_governance.note: These enterprise/org rulesets govern every change to main and supersede the solo-dev branch_policy. They must be satisfied through the normal PR flow; do not bypass.
enforced: Pull request required - no direct push to main (org ruleset 'default-branch-protection')
No force-push (non_fast_forward) and no branch deletion on main
CodeQL code scanning must pass - high-or-higher / error threshold (org ruleset)
Code quality checks must pass at 'errors' severity (org ruleset)
Copilot code review runs on push (org ruleset)
All GitHub Actions must be pinned to a full-length commit SHA (enterprise Actions policy)
File-path restriction on '.github/agents/*.md' and 'agents/*.md' (enterprise ruleset; bypass: EnterpriseOwner only)
enterprise_governance.bypass: The code-scanning/quality/Copilot-review ruleset has NO bypass actors; admin bypass does not apply. Merge only via passing checks.

workflow_pack_solo.note: basecoat ships ~95 org-scale workflows across team/regulated packs. The solo pack keeps only asset validation, token lint, and optional docs build.

secrets.note: secrets_mode=local - no repo/org secrets required for the solo pack. Never commit secrets; see .gitignore.

scan_scope.note: vendor/basecoat is read-only and validated upstream; sheen CI never scans it.

upgrade_path.how: Set branch_policy=shared, enable branch_protection, add reviewer/PR-gate workflows, move telemetry/secrets to workflow scope.
